title: MEP BIM Engineer
description:
**Location :- Indore**  
**Experience :- 3 to 8**  
**Job Description :-**

**What We're Looking For**

* **B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.**
* Experience in Plumbing BIM Modelling and Coordination.
* Proficiency in Autodesk Revit MEP, Autodesk Revit Fabrication, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and ACC/BIM 360.
* Strong understanding of BEP, CDE, LOD, ISO 19650, and QA/QC processes.
* Experience delivering international projects.
* Strong working knowledge of Dynamo and/or Python scripting, with proven ability to build automation tools that improve team-wide BIM workflow efficiency.

**Technical Expertise**

* Domestic hot and cold water supply systems, including pipe sizing and routing.
* Sanitary drainage, waste, and vent (DWV) systems.
* Storm water and rainwater drainage, including rainwater harvesting systems.
* Fire fighting systems: sprinklers, hydrants, hose reels, and wet/dry riser networks.
* Pump room layouts, water treatment, and booster pump system coordination.
* Coordination of pipe supports, insulation, and access provisions for maintenance.
* Codes and standards: IPC, UPC, BS EN 806/752, NFPA 13/14/20.
* Advanced coordination of complex pipe routing and riser layouts in high-density MEP zones.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
